subpages.text: top of page HOME About Services Products Contact Employment More Use tab to navigate through the menu items. Get Support Submit a Ticket WHAT WE DO Micro Technology Consultants, Inc. (MTC), was founded in 1990 by Randy Smith. MTC is a technology integration firm that provides enterprise IT infrastructure products and services including networking, server, backup, security, surveillance and access control. In order to provide a superior level of project integration, MTC has earned some of the industry’s exceptional certifications. MTC has provided ERATE and technology integration services to over 100 schools in Georgia. We have provided 25+ new-construction school projects that were a turnkey venture for MTC. We protect the investment of technology for our clients by providing in-house industry certified employees that are insured and drug-free. MTC is liability insured and performance bonded. ​ All service and installation projects are implemented with our company owned service fleet of vehicles and in-house employees. MTC is housed in a 14,000 square foot office, service center, and warehouse complex located in Warner Robins, Georgia. ​ With three decades of past experience in offering computer, cable, and network design services, MTC can provide your integration projects a “single source” vendor. A turnkey service assures that your project will be as closely engineered as possible. No service offered by MTC is ever contracted out; MTC personnel perform all of our services completely in-house.
